about: An event written on another staff than its voice's, a chord head on the other staff, an arpeggio over both staves (G01 §8.3, §8.5, A21, A24).
spec: G01 §8.3: event.staff is where the event is written, voice.staff its home; a chord note on another staff is head.staff. Appendix A: arpeggiate marks at one onset make one Arpeggio spanner.
